data.name: DecaDungeons™
data.detailed_description:
The Story:

Long ago, the kingdom prospered, surrounded by vast forests, towering mountains, and calm seas. The castle stood proudly over the town, and families lived in peace… until one fateful night, when Death itself rode through the gates on a black horse.

It moved silently through the streets, and everything in its wake fell to ruin. Fire, plague, and agony followed. Bodies filled the streets, cries faded into silence, and a terrible curse took hold.

Since that day, every family has borne the weight of a broken pact. Once every ten years, a chosen one must face the darkness in the hope of breaking the spell.

A secret council selects a new knight, forging together a magical six-sided die, each face guiding the fate of a shattered world. Now, the chosen rides toward the ten forbidden dungeons, where shadows cling to the walls… and deep within, monsters await the dice-wielding knight.

The Game:

DecaDungeons™ is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler (DRPG) built entirely with the Smile Game Builder engine. Explore minimalistic yet atmospheric 3D pixel-art-style environments, and fight your way through 10 deadly dungeons to save the kingdom. In this game you will have to fight your way through powerful foes. Between the fighting and the exploration, you can try to find all of the 50 Red Coins hidden across the dungeons...

Rare Monsters:

Some battles have a 1 in 100 chance of spawning a rare, rainbow-coloured monster that drops huge amounts of EXP and gold. Will you be able to find one?

Events!:

While exploring, you’ll encounter special events that present short scenarios with three possible outcomes. Your choice can help you… or harm you. Think carefully before acting, luck may not always be on your side!

The Council Has Spoken:

The kingdom’s fate now lies in the hands of the new dice-wielding knight. Will you conquer the curse, or watch the realm fall into darkness?

Key Features:

  • 10 unique, trap-filled dungeons to explore

  • Turn-based first-person combat

  • 50 hidden Red Coins to discover

  • Rare monsters with big EXP and gold rewards

  • Random events with branching outcomes

  • Atmospheric 3D pixel-art style

  • Fully playable with keyboard or controller

The game is fully playable with both keyboard and controller, though a controller is strongly recommended for the best experience.

DecaDungeons™ was created entirely within Smile Game Builder, without any Unity export or custom programming. It’s a pure showcase of what’s possible in SGB. But keep in mind, the engine has its limits.

data.short_description: DecaDungeons™ is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler where fate is decided by a magical six-sided dice. Explore 10 deadly dungeons, battle fierce foes, hunt rare monsters, and survive events that can help or harm you in a cursed kingdom’s fight for survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 32/64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-760 (4 * 2800) or equivalent / AMD Athlon II X4 645 AM3 (4 * 3100) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6670, GeForce GTX 200 series with at least 1GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Performance is not guaranteed under a virtual or emulated environment.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 32/64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent / AMD FX-6350 (6 * 3900) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 (2048 MB) / Radeon HD 7970 (3072 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Performance is not guaranteed under a virtual or emulated environment.
